# Tax Filing Calendar

Quarterly and yearly filing dates for the business, collected in one place so they land in the calendar early. Each entry has the date, what is filed, and who prepares it. The bookkeeper prepares the returns; I approve them at least three days before the date. Details about the regime I am in are in [[atalanyado-es-afa]].
